acceptance_criteria.statement: A claim with title, notes, amount, category meals, status draft, and an expense date can be created with POST /claims and answers 201 with its identifier and echoed fields
GET /claims answers 200 and includes every created claim
GET /claims/{claim_id} answers 200 with the exact stored claim
PUT /claims/{claim_id} approves a claim and later rejects it, changing only the status
DELETE /claims/{claim_id} answers 204 and a later fetch of the same claim answers 404
With an access key configured, a request without the key answers 401
A claim placed in a named vendor shows that vendor when fetched, and the vendor is present in GET /claim_vendors
Amount and expense date set at creation are still present after every status update
A claim created without notes or expense date answers 201 and stores no expense date
